attributes.name: Raytheon Company
attributes.blurb: Defense contractor; merged with UTC. Surviving company exists as a subsidiary of the renamed UTC, company, Raytheon Technologies
attributes.summary:
Raytheon is a major American defense contractor that specializes in defense and homeland security technology. As the world’s largest producer of guided missiles, Raytheon specializes in manufacturing defense systems and defense electronics. 

A member of the defense electronic industry, Raytheon is most active lobbying on defense, homeland security and federal budget appropriation issues.

attributes.name: Massachusetts High Technology Council
attributes.blurb: Business association for high tech employers in MA.
attributes.summary: The MA High Tech Council is a trade association for high tech employers, focused on influencing state and local government to create a pro-business environment in Massachusetts.  The group claims to support investments in "infrastructure, research, human resources development and development and services" as opposed to subsidies and direct payments to businesses.  The council is against increases to corporate taxes, arguing that MA should be a level playing field with other states in order to attract business.  Advocates for the business community to take a leadership role in the state's education system.  Members are CEO level executives.  http://www.mhtc.org
